description: This Java class is a builder for creating immutable access control lists (ACLs) with a fluent API, supporting operations like adding, removing, and initializing ACL entries.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlListBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableAccessControlList objects with a fluent API, supporting setting, removing, and bulk operations on ACL entries.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new empty builder for an AccessControlList.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a given iterable of AclEntry objects.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces an ACL entry in the builder.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple ACL entries in the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific ACL entry or by authorization subject.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable AccessControlList from the current entries.
